title: Start-of-year price increases seen lifting monthly US consumer inflation in January
load_bearing_forecast_sentence: The CPI likely increased by 0.3% after a similar gain in December, a Reuters survey of economists predicted. Estimates ranged from a 0.1% gain to a 0.4% rise.
core_forecast_sentence: Excluding the volatile food and energy components, the CPI is expected to have increased 0.3% after rising 0.2% in December.
yoy_forecast_sentence: In the 12 months through January, the CPI is forecast to have advanced 2.5%. / the so-called core CPI was forecast to have increased 2.5% after advancing 2.6% in December.
target_disambiguation: headline MoM = 0.3% (unqualified 'The CPI'); core MoM = 0.3% (explicitly 'excluding the volatile food and energy components'); headline YoY = 2.5%; core YoY = 2.5%.
